_draft: DRAFT purposes: why a place was built or a ship came. class: a ship purpose's hull class. rooms: names its structure gives its rooms (room_<key> params). holds: the loot table its lockers take. clue: the datapad left inside, rendered with the event's fills ({civ}, {site}, figures, vars). The owner rewrites names and clues. station_purposes: station purposes (station_plan.md section 4): what a station was built for, rolled by its founding event from the map's present.station_purposes among those its arc can found. frame and decks shape it; modules it always has, optional ones by percent; holds stock its cargo; rooms and clue name and explain it; sealed locks a module's door; event_weights and chapter_weights tilt the history. The owner rewrites room names and clues.

relay.clue: Relay telemetry of the {civ}: carrier steady, no operator logged in.

research.clue: Research log of the {civ}: findings filed, funding cut, crew rotated home.

refinery.clue: Shift log of the {civ} refinery: quota met, quota raised, quota met.

shipyard.clue: Yard ledger of the {civ}: three hulls laid down, one launched.

garrison.clue: Standing orders of the {civ} garrison: hold the station. No relief is coming.

habitat.clue: Census of the {civ} habitat: births up, rations down, hope steady.

survey.clue: Survey log of the {civ}: charted {site}; nothing here worth the fuel to come back for.

courier.clue: Courier pouch, seal broken: orders for a {civ} fleet that never got them.

cargo.clue: Manifest of the {civ}: ore and alloy, bound for a market that is gone now.

smuggling.clue: Two manifests aboard: the one for inspectors, and the true one, in a {civ} cipher.

colony_hold.clue: Colony roster of the {civ}: four hundred names, a world chosen for them, and {site} was not it.

refugees.clue: We took everyone who could still walk. The {civ} behind us did not stop.

warship.clue: Battle log of the {civ}: engaged, hull breached, going down over {site}.

prison_hulk.clue: Prisoner transfer, {civ} authority: twelve held, none to be released.

flagship.clue: Flag log of the {civ} fleet: the line broke above {site}; we went down with it.

seat.clue: The {civ} kept their law here. The last page of it is torn out.

prison.clue: Ledger of the {civ}: those held here, and what for. Most of the reasons are the same.

fort.clue: Watch log of the {civ}: the enemy's fires on the far ridge, every night, a little nearer.

dwelling.clue: A family record of the {civ}: births, deaths, a harvest that failed.

temple.clue: A prayer of the {civ}, worn smooth by hands, for rain that would not come.

observatory.clue: Sky charts of the {civ}, with one light marked again and again: the ship that came.

archive.clue: Index of the {civ} archive: everything they knew, filed under a name we cannot read.

plague_study.clue: Ward notes, {civ} hand: the sick are not to be fed after the third bell, and not to be let out.

xenobiology.clue: Specimen log of the {civ}: it does not die. It waits.

weapons_research.clue: Test report of the {civ}: yield exceeded estimates. Recommend the next test be held elsewhere.

command.clue: Orders of the {civ}, unsigned: launch on confirmation. Confirmation received.

mine_office.clue: Claim ledger of the {civ}: tonnage out, crews in, and a column for the dead.

forced_labour.clue: Work roll of the {civ}: quotas, and the names of the {enemy} who did not meet them.

hideout.clue: Scratched on the wall, in {civ} script: they are still out there. Do not light a fire.

grave.clue: Names of the {civ} dead, and one line under them all: we will not be the last.

battlefield.clue: A soldier's letter of the {civ}, never sent: the {enemy} came at dawn with {weapon}.

landing.clue: Landing schedule of the {civ}: one ship a season, until the seasons stopped.
